paragraphs: Simple Higher Ed sells a connected suite of three products for colleges and universities: Simple Syllabus, Simple Prep, and Simple TA. Simple Syllabus is a template-driven platform that lets instructors personalize and publish interactive class syllabi within the LMS. Simple Prep is a course readiness tool for institutions, covering course quality in and outside of the LMS. Simple TA is an AI teaching assistant that delivers real-time, course-aligned support powered by syllabus and LMS data.

The company was founded in 2017 to solve the challenge of syllabus publishing and now counts more than 600 colleges and universities nationwide. Simple Syllabus is used by more than 5,000,000 students a year to reach their class syllabus across web, mobile, and print formats. The about page describes a team of more than 30 professionals behind that suite. Simple Higher Ed designs, develops, and supports its technology in Tampa, Florida.
Institutions are the stated market, and the events listed on the home page cover syllabus management, course readiness, and course support.

quote.text: Trusted by over 600 colleges and universities, Simple Higher Ed helps institutions solve complex challenges
